title: Share Once — post-once board with per-post audience selection
status: COMPLETE — all three milestones SHIPPED on the Convex deployment. Milestone 1: create posts + audience resolution + author/received lists + audience picker options. Milestone 2: open a post from an invite link, mark viewed, forward a post into chats, re-post to my own Share Once page, list forward targets. Milestone 3: full delete + tombstone parity with 1:1 chat (delete for me / for receiver / for everyone) plus viewer-initiated delete requests the author accepts or declines.
concept: Share Once sits just below Chat Once. The author posts ONE item of any content type (text/photo/video/audio/voice/scanned document/file) and picks exactly who can view it. Each selected viewer gets a tappable invite link (shareToken) that opens the author's Share Once page to view that specific post. Purpose: avoid forwarding the same file one-by-one, and avoid filling recipients' storage.
menuPlacement: Add a 'Share Once' entry directly BELOW the existing 'Chat Once' entry.

contentModel.mediaUpload: Same 3-step flow as chat media: (1) api.messages.generateUploadUrl() -> upload URL string; (2) POST the bytes with Content-Type header -> { storageId }; (3) pass storageId to shareOnce.createPost. Photos taken, videos recorded, documents scanned, audio recorded, and picked files all become one of the types above.
contentModel.fields: text (body or caption), storageId, mediaUrl (alt to storageId), fileName, fileSize, mimeType, duration, fileHash (SHA-256 hex of plaintext bytes, same 'receive once' meaning as messages.fileHash).

modes.all: Everyone in my connections (contacts + prior 1:1s + matched synced device contacts, minus blocked/system/self).
modes.allExcept: Everyone in my connections EXCEPT audienceExceptIds (the tick boxes you untick).
modes.specific: Exactly audienceUserIds (the tick boxes you tick).

audience.groups: audienceGroupIds is merged into the viewer set for EVERY mode (same procedure as selecting users). Members of each selected group you belong to become viewers.
audience.search: getAudienceOptions returns the full connections list; filter by name client-side for the search box.
audience.security: The audience is resolved SERVER-SIDE on every createPost. A tampered client can never widen its own audience. Blocked users, system accounts and the author are always excluded.

returns.connections: Array<{ userId: Id<users>, name: string, avatar?: string }> — sorted by name, for the searchable tick list
returns.trusteeIds: Id<users>[] — highlight/preview which connections are trustees
returns.groups: Array<{ groupId: Id<conversations>, name: string, memberCount: number }>

args.text: string (optional; REQUIRED and non-empty for type 'text'; caption otherwise)
args.storageId: Id<_storage> (required for non-text unless mediaUrl is given)
args.mediaUrl: string (optional CDN url alternative to storageId)
args.fileHash: string (optional; SHA-256 hex of plaintext bytes)

createPost.notes: The invite link to deliver to each viewer is `<app-origin>/share-once/view?t=<shareToken>` (web). Native should send its own tappable deep link carrying the shareToken to every resolved viewer. Viewer rows are materialized immediately; viewerCount is how many people can now view.
errors: BAD_REQUEST (empty text / missing media / oversized text or file name)

listMyPosts.returns: Array<ContentView & { viewerCount: number, viewedCount: number }> — my own posts, newest first, excluding ones I deleted for myself

listPostViewers.returns: Array<{ viewerId, name, avatar?, viewedAt: string|null, deleted: boolean }> — author only; who can view and who has viewed

listReceived.returns: Array<ContentView & { authorId, authorName, authorAvatar?, viewed: boolean }> — posts shared WITH me, newest first. Hidden once I or the author deleted it for me, unless it is a delete-for-everyone tombstone (isDeleted true), which stays visible as a tombstone.

getPostByToken.returns: ViewerAccess | null — null when the token is unknown or I am neither the author nor in the audience (or I deleted it for myself). Use this to open a post from a tapped invite link.
getPostByToken.notes: Does NOT mark the post viewed. Call markViewed separately after opening.

getPost.returns: ViewerAccess | null — same authorization as getPostByToken but keyed by post id.

returns.viewed: boolean (false if I am not in the audience, e.g. the author)

markViewed.notes: Idempotent. Records the ISO timestamp the first time I open a received post; no-op afterwards. Call once when a viewer opens the post.

args.targetConversationIds: Id<conversations>[] (1..10 of my chats; use listForwardTargets)

returns.forwardedTo: number (how many chats actually received it)

forwardToConversations.notes: Forwards the post into my 1:1/group chats as normal chat messages. Reuses the SAME global 'FW' counter and 'receive once' file dedup as messages.forwardMessage, so recipients who already have the file see it auto-hidden. Author OR audience member may forward. Skips any target I'm not a participant of.
errors: BAD_REQUEST (0 or >10 targets, or deleted post)

repostToShareOnce.notes: Creates a NEW post on MY OWN Share Once page carrying the original content, with a fresh audience I choose, stamped as forwarded (isForwarded true, incrementing 'FW'). This is what backs offering 'Share Once' as a forward target. Author OR audience member may re-post.
errors: FORBIDDEN (phone not verified, or not author/audience)

listForwardTargets.returns: Array<{ conversationId: Id<conversations>, name: string, avatar?: string, isGroup: boolean }> — my 1:1 chats and groups, sorted by name, for the 'forward to chats' picker. Filter by name client-side for search.

args.forReceiverIds: Id<users>[] (optional; subset of viewers for forReceiver, defaults to ALL viewers)

deletePost.notes: EXACT parity with messages.deleteMessage. forEveryone (author only): wipes storageId/mediaUrl/fileName/fileSize/mimeType/duration and sets isDeleted=true + text='This post was deleted' — every viewer keeps seeing that tombstone. forReceiver (author only): sets shareOnceAudience.deleted=true for the targeted viewers (or all), hiding it from them while the author keeps it. Neither flag = delete-for-me: the author sets deletedForAuthor (hidden from their own page, viewers unaffected); a viewer sets their own shareOnceAudience.deleted (hidden for them, unless it later becomes a global tombstone).

requestDeletion.notes: A viewer asks the author to delete the post for everyone (parity with messages.requestDeletion). Inserts a pending shareOnceDeletionRequests row. One pending request per (viewer, post).

getPendingDeletionRequests.returns: Array<{ _id: Id<shareOnceDeletionRequests>, postId, requesterId, requesterName, requesterAvatar?, postPreview, postType, createdAt: number }> — pending delete requests on MY posts, newest first. Show these to the author so they can accept/decline.

respondToDeletionRequest.notes: Author accepts or declines. Accept performs the SAME wipe as deletePost forEveryone (tombstone for all viewers) and marks the request accepted; decline just marks it declined.

ContentView.mediaUrl: string | null (signed URL resolved from storageId; null when deleted)
ContentView.preview: string (chats-list style preview, e.g. '📷 Photo', or the tombstone text when deleted)

ViewerAccess.isAuthor: boolean (true if the current user is the author)
ViewerAccess.viewed: boolean (true if I have already opened it)

viewerCapabilities: When viewing a post (getPostByToken/getPost): open & zoom photos/documents, play/watch MP3/MP4 via mediaUrl, download the file, forward to my chats (forwardToConversations), and re-post to my own Share Once page (repostToShareOnce). Call markViewed once on open.

webRoutes.author: /share-once (compose + your posts + delete-request banner + a 'Received' tab)
webRoutes.viewer: /share-once/view?t=<shareToken> (opens a specific post from an invite link; header menu has delete-for-me / delete-for-receivers / delete-for-everyone for the author, and delete-for-me / ask-author-to-delete for a viewer)

notes: Share Once is offered as a forward TARGET when forwarding messages/files to contacts via repostToShareOnce (carries content + a fresh audience).
Delete behaves exactly like 1:1 chat: delete for me / for receiver / for everyone, leaving a 'This post was deleted' tombstone; viewers can request the author delete for everyone.
